climate_pressure: Changing rainfall and environmental stress affecting grazing and water resources.
documented_impact: DPPA describes altered transhumance and pressure around refugee-hosting areas outside Mbera.
fcv_mediator: Longstanding resentments, grazing competition and unequal representation/access among arrival cohorts.
possible_consequence: Potential host–refugee or inter-herder tensions; no climate-attributable violence incidence is estimated.
alternative_explanations: Historical resentments, representation, services and insecurity in neighbouring Mali also shape pressures.
uncertainty: Source-stated conditional pathway in an executive summary; underlying incident evidence not reviewed, not proof that climate caused armed violence. Not independently reverified in the 27 October 2026 remediation; check the cited passage before relying on this claim.
resilience_factors: Communal committees and inclusive resource governance are identified capacities, with effectiveness unverified.
compact_statement: Around Mbera, climate-related resource pressure can interact with longstanding grievances and grazing/water access; tensions are conditional, not inevitable.
